name: Fabled Kingdoms
description:
About This Game

Step into a world torn apart by ancient powers, fractured kingdoms, and rising factions of war. 

Fabled Kingdoms is a turn-based fantasy strategy game where you command unique factions, build armies, and engage in tactical grid-based combat across a story-driven campaign. Every faction brings its own identity, mechanics, and playstyle—ranging from arcane spellcasters and undead legions to primal beast tribes and ancient civilizations.

Position your units carefully, combine abilities, and exploit terrain advantages to outsmart your enemies. From brutal frontline clashes to powerful magical synergies, every battle rewards planning and tactical awareness.

Command Distinct Factions

Lead multiple unique factions, each with its own identity and playstyle.

The Stormguard are a versatile, all-round human faction, adapting to any battlefield situation. The Beastmen are savage tribal warbands that overwhelm enemies through raw aggression.

The ancient Primordials unite elves, dwarves, satyrs, and forest beings, drawing power from nature and old magic. The Fallen rise as an undead force fueled by necrotic energy and battlefield death.

The Arcanists wield advanced arcane power, constructs, and reality-bending magic. The Dwarfkin are disciplined mountain clans, relying on strict formations, coordination, and unbreakable defense.

The Lizardmen are a primal, highly pious jungle and swamp civilization, blending faith with feral strength.

Each faction offers distinct units, abilities, and strategic approaches, making every battle and campaign feel different depending on who you command.

Tactical Turn-Based Combat

Fight grid-based battles where positioning, timing, and unit synergy decide every encounter. Use terrain, abilities, and faction mechanics to outplay your enemies.

Capture and control strategic buildings such as barracks, towers, and resource points to gain reinforcements, economic advantages, and map control. Holding key locations can shift the momentum of an entire battle.

Every decision matters, from unit placement to territorial control.

A Narrative Campaign

Experience a multi-act story set across diverse regions of the world, following different factions as they struggle for power, survival, and dominance.
short_desc: A turn-based fantasy strategy game where you command powerful factions, build your forces, and outmaneuver enemies across tactical grid-based battles in a rich narrative campaign. Make use of tactics, terrain, and unit abilities win your battles!
